scenario_title: Webhook retries without jitter exhausted Lambda concurrency
title: Throttling (429) on billing-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] billing-svc 2026-07-01 19:16-23:26: billing-svc: 281 of 364 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-07-01 19:16 and 2026-07-01 23:26 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span.
error_templates: c.f.b.client.NotificationClient - call to notification-svc failed: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
c.f.b.api.UsageController - account <*> requested usage for a closed period

_templates.macro: Config change raised {key} {old} -> {new}; one failing customer endpoint multiplied invocations until notification-svc hit its Lambda concurrency limit and invoice e-mails were throttled.
_templates.remediation: Revert {key} to {old}; add exponential backoff with jitter and a per-endpoint circuit breaker.

culprit.diff:
@@ -32,3 +32,3 @@ webhook.max_retries
 webhook:
-  max_retries: 3
+  max_retries: 24
   # managed by the platform team

rca.macro: Config change raised webhook.max_retries 3 -> 24; one failing customer endpoint multiplied invocations until notification-svc hit its Lambda concurrency limit and invoice e-mails were throttled.
rca.remediation: Revert webhook.max_retries to 3; add exponential backoff with jitter and a per-endpoint circuit breaker.
